state.task: Advisory review of complete six-number Jamaica Lotto candidate tickets (6 of 1-38) for draw #2340, using only pre-draw evidence through draw #2339.

statistical_context.gate_rule: Holm-adj full-sample one-sided p<0.05 AND development p<0.05 AND confirmation p<0.05
statistical_context.note_2339: Prior ticket 01-04-13-14-24-38 hit 3/6; P(>=3 | random ticket)=0.0387; one observation, not evidence of skill.

choice_strongest_case.instructions: Given only the supplied pre-draw empirical evidence in `statistical_context` and `candidates`, which complete candidate ticket has the strongest overall case among these alternatives?

robustness_C01.instructions: How robust is the walk-forward backtest support for candidate C01 (01-06-13-18-25-33) across development and confirmation periods, relative to the random expectation of 0.947 matches?
criteria: Below or at random expectation, or inconsistent between periods
Slightly above random in one period only
Modestly above random in both periods but not statistically significant
Clearly and significantly above random in both periods

agreement_C01.instructions: How much do independent ranking models agree on the numbers in candidate C01 (01-06-13-18-25-33), per `models_count_of_ticket_numbers_in_their_top10`?
criteria: Little agreement: most models place few of its numbers in their top 10
Mixed agreement
Broad agreement across most models

overfit_C01.instructions: Is any apparent merit of candidate C01 (01-06-13-18-25-33) likely attributable to chance or overfitting rather than real predictive signal?

one_model_C01.instructions: Does the case for candidate C01 (01-06-13-18-25-33) depend mainly on a single model?

stronger_than_random_C01.instructions: Is the evidence for candidate C01 (01-06-13-18-25-33) materially stronger than for a randomly chosen valid ticket?
